name: Sekerbank T.A.S.
summary: Sekerbank T.A.S. provides agricultural, business, SME, corporate, and retail banking services in Turkey and internationally. It operates through Corporate/Commercial, SME, Retail, Treasury/Investment, and Other segments. The company offers personal loans, ECOcredit, vehicle and home loans, and completing accounts; and credit and individual bank cards, and cash advance. It also provides deposit products, including term and demand deposits; investment products, such as investment accounts, FX trading platforms, repo transactions, treasury bill/government bonds, Eurobonds, gold transactions, stocks, private sector debt instruments, foreign stock exchanges, investment funds, derivative products,…
